description: Add quadratic features (x^2, y^2, x*y) to allow simple non-linear boundaries; expect val_loss to drop since spirals need non-linear features.
Switch optimizer to Adam (with LR 0.01) for faster, more stable convergence vs plain SGD; expect val_loss to drop by better optimization
Add polar features (r, sin(theta), cos(theta)) to better capture spiral structure; expect val_loss to drop as model can use angular info.
Add one hidden tanh layer (16 units) with full-batch SGD to give non-linear capacity; expect val_loss to drop as MLP can better separate spirals.
Add biases to both layers (b1, b2) and update them with SGD; expect small improvement because biases let the network shift activations and better fit the spiral patterns.
Use SGD with momentum (0.9) instead of plain SGD; expect faster, more stable convergence and lower val_loss within the same time budget.
